free_tier.stated: 10 devices, 1 network, non-commercial use. Vendor table effective 20 Oct 2026: 'Personal | Free | 10 | Not available'.

egress.terms: free, peer-to-peer; relaying only when the path fails.

interface_detail: virtual L2/L3 overlay, REST API, Terraform provider, CLI.
tooling: zerotier-one agent; central controller is now separately licensed (the default `make` build no longer includes it).
chaining: 10 devices is workable as a private mesh but not as a shard farm, and the controller is no longer in the open-source build by default.
limits_note: device count, not bandwidth. Data flows peer-to-peer so there is no byte meter.
reliability_note: free tier has been cut twice (50 -> 25 -> 10 devices). Docs at docs.zerotier.com/start/ still say 'up to 25 devices' while the vendor's own llms-full.txt says 10 — trust the vendor table, not the docs page.
